title: 실제 유물이 말한다(레이어 리그)
when: relic 재료에 jaw 가 있을 때 — base · mouth · jaw 레이어를 리그로 묶어 말하는 구간에만 턱을 움직인다

vars.HX: 턱 경첩 x px(재료 그림 기준)

steps.jsx: var nm=["base","mouth","jaw"];var sx=@FLIP@*@SCALE@/100,sy=@SCALE@/100;var R=C.layers.addNull();R.name="@WHO@ rig";R.moveToBeginning();R.startTime=0;R.inPoint=@T0@;R.outPoint=@T1@;var RT=R.property("Transform");RT.property("Anchor Point").setValue([0,0]);K(RT.property("Position"),[[@T0@,[@X@,@Y@+50]],[@T0@+0.2,[@X@,@Y@]]]);var rk=[[@T0@,0]];for(var t=@T0@+0.5,s=1;t<@T1@;t+=0.9,s=-s)rk.push([t,s*@NOD@]);K(RT.property("Rotation"),rk);EASE(RT.property("Rotation"),60);var jx=(@HX@-@NX@)*sx,jy=(@HY@-@NY@)*sy;var J=null;for(var i=0;i<3;i++){var it=app.project.importFile(new ImportOptions(new File("$MATDIR/@WHO@_"+nm[i]+".png")));var l=C.layers.add(it);l.name="@WHO@ "+nm[i];l.moveToBeginning();l.startTime=0;l.inPoint=@T0@;l.outPoint=@T1@;l.parent=R;var T=l.property("Transform");T.property("Anchor Point").setValue(i==2?[@HX@,@HY@]:[@NX@,@NY@]);T.property("Scale").setValue([sx*100,sy*100]);T.property("Position").setValue(i==2?[jx,jy]:[0,0]);if(i==2)J=T;}var pk=[[@S0@,[jx,jy]]],rt=[[@S0@,0]];var pat=[1,0.35,0.8,0.15,1,0.5,0.1,0.7,0.3,0.9,0.05];var n=0;for(var t2=@S0@+0.09;t2<@S1@-0.1;t2+=0.11+(n%3)*0.03){var a=pat[n%pat.length];pk.push([t2,[jx,jy+a*@OPEN@*sy]]);rt.push([t2,-(@FLIP@)*a*@TILT@]);n++;}pk.push([@S1@,[jx,jy]]);rt.push([@S1@,0]);K(J.property("Position"),pk);K(J.property("Rotation"),rt);
